title: Premier Redeemer Allowance: Certificates Issued or Reissued in Twelve Months (Pals Rewards and Tailwise Plus)
content:
**Pals Rewards and Tailwise Plus.** On a move up from Tailwise Plus Annual to Tailwise Plus Premier Annual, a Premier redeemer allowance — a flat dollar amount — is subtracted from the upgrade charge according to the certificates issued or reissued on the rewards ledger in the last 12 months: certificate issue entries and certificate reissue entries dated in the last 12 months, counted together.

| Certificates issued or reissued in the last 12 months | Premier redeemer allowance |
|---|---|
| 5 or more | $3.00 |
| 3 or 4 | $1.50 |
| fewer than 3 | none |

**Counting (hypothetical).** Three certificates issued and one reissued in the last 12 months make 4: $1.50. A further reissue makes 5: $3.00. Two issued and nothing reissued: none.
